    Galaxy XR Temporary Root Reported Working on October 2026 Firmware#

    Temporary root reported working on Galaxy XR firmware I610UES3AZJ2 using DirtyFrag and KernelSU GXR. Build instructions are available on GitHub.

    Developer booinspace has published a method for rooting the Galaxy XR on the newest firmware I610UES3AZJ2.

    The project supposedly combines DirtyFrag with the new addresses targeting the newest firmware and should work with the old KernelSU GXR by 4uva4ek.

    According to booinspace, the method was successfully tested on the new firmware with KernelSU correctly reporting it as working.

    As with DirtyFrag's original method, root access is lost on full reboot, so it still requires the apply on reboot to stay actuve.

    The repository includes build scripts and instructions rather than prebuilt APKs. While the developer reports a successful test, independent verification is still limited.

    Users beware, this is still root we are talking about, everyone should still be aware of potential crashes and Knox-related risks.

• 3 Nov 2026Release@AngelDark92

    SteamLink - Official Galaxy XR Support#

    High-resolution now triggered on SL with no patches. Some small problems still linger.

    SteamLink builds 5002395 and 5002527 now trigger high resolution without the aid of any of the patches, they have moved to a four per-eye layer entries, with at least two confirmed as quads, and no separate underside swapchain like on earlier apks.

    Only a few other problems remain:

    • Editing bandwidth and encoded frame size to anything more than auto starts to throttle the stream so it's very difficult to reach the same quality/performance as 2.0.20 with higher bitrates and resolution
    • The hand input seems to be at the wrong angle
    • There is not enough prediction openxr side as to allow for async spacewap trigger, so head movements show the sides of the frame and cause motion sickness on some people as the stream seems to lag behind head movement.
    • The image is not yet well calibrated for oled screens.

• 29 Oct 2026Site update@AngelDark92

    A News tab, and a cleaner way around the Forge#

    The Forge has a News tab. Releases, guides, project milestones and site changes land here, newest first. Every post has its own link, so a headline can be shared without pointing at the whole page.

    The navigation now works like tabs instead of a row of buttons: Catalog, Kernel modules, Changelog and News. Each action sits on the tab it belongs to — Star on GitHub in the hero, Suggest a repo in the Catalog header, Post news in the News header. The Filters button moved into the catalog toolbar next to the search box, and it shows how many filters are on.

    Anyone can propose a post: use Post news on the News tab. It opens a prefilled issue, CI prepares the post and a pull request, and a maintainer reviews it before it appears here.
